data.name: Breadoria
data.detailed_description:
Build a colony. Play as a Bread. Try not to get eaten.

Breadoria is a survival colony sim about a group of living Breads trying to build a home in a strange land. Gather resources, construct buildings, craft tools, manage storage, and prepare your settlement before hungry invaders come looking for their next meal.

Control any Bread

Every Bread is part of your colony, but any Bread can become your main character. Control any Bread to gather, craft, fight, or explore, then switch to another whenever you like.

Automate the colony

Every Bread can be controlled manually or assigned a job, allowing you to switch seamlessly between playing a character and managing an entire colony. Send them to gather resources, craft tools, patrol the area, or keep the colony running while you focus on building, defending, or controlling another character.

As your colony grows, your Breads can handle more work, giving you more time to plan, expand, and deal with bigger threats.

Gather, craft, and expand

Collect materials such as wood and stone, organize resources in storage buildings, and craft tools to gather resources more efficiently. Build useful structures, manage your supplies, and shape the layout of your settlement piece by piece.

Defend your Breads

Your colony is not safe forever. Enemies are drawn to the Breads and will attack your people. Build walls, position your units, and protect your citizens from becoming actual food.

Switch freely between managing your colony and controlling individual Breads whenever you want.
